info.name: IPQualityScore Device Fingerprint IP Reputation API
Proxy, VPN, Tor, and IP reputation lookup.

params.name: ip
params.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up.

params.name: strictness
params.description: Adjusts lookup depth and sensitivity (0-3). 1 is recommended.

params.name: user_agent
params.description: User's browser user agent for improved accuracy.

params.name: allow_public_access_points
params.description: Bypass checks for public access points such as universities.

params.name: order_amount
params.description: Transaction Scoring - the order amount for the transaction.

items.docs: Scores an IP address for proxy, VPN, and Tor usage, bot status, recent abuse, and abuse velocity, returning a 0-100 fraud score plus geolocation and connection metadata. Adding optional billing, shipping, payment, and order parameters enables Transaction Scoring, returning an additional transaction_details object.
